headings: (500 ML) WHITE LOTUS HAND AND BODY CREAM

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) WHITE LOTUS HAND AND BODY CREAM
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand and body cream. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

White Lotus | A floral aroma, primarily lotus flower and violet with hints of mandarin and wood that create a warm atmosphere.

Notes:
Top notes: mandarin, peach, botanical.
Heart notes: lotus, rose, sambac jasmine.
Base notes: cedar wood, sandalwood, cashmere wood, musk.
